g.text: Panel synthetic-window-arnt-shared-scale-v1: Synthetic plus/minus windows with one pinned Arnt matrix | 1 resolved matrices
Reference: synthetic-genome-v1 | assembly: synthetic-assembly-v1 | annotation: synthetic-annotation-v1
SCALE: Same accession: shared range across ALL report TSSs and both strands; different matrices remain independent.
Transcript-oriented sequence: 5'-to-3' left to right; genomic labels descend.
Solid: motif-local + / genomic -. Dashed: motif-local - / genomic +. Black vertical rule: 0 bp, annotated TSS.
Every point is a motif-window START on the common sequence axis (not a center or reverse-motif 5' endpoint).
Gray: terminal positions without a full motif window. Amber and path gaps: unavailable windows (including N), not zero scores.

PFM logos: p(base) * [2 - Shannon entropy] bits; uniform DNA reference, no pseudocount or small-sample correction. Logo bits are not track scores.
